sn45.37:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you brahminhood and the fruits of brahminhood.
sn45.37:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.37:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, are the fruits of brahminhood?
sn45.37:1.9: The fruit of stream-entry, the fruit of once-returning, the fruit of nonreturning, the fruit of arahantship.
sn45.37:1.10: These are called the fruits of brahminhood.”
